title: Maximum lot coverage for residences in Commercial Districts
previewText: In Commercial Districts, for residential buildings, or the residential portion of mixed buildings, the maximum lot coverage regulations of Section 62-333 (Maximum lot coverage in Residence Districts) shall apply.
